reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended The shutdown logic now iterates over a snapshot to close every managed connection, with a regression test covering complete cleanup and zero active connections. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This pull request fixes `Environment.close()` so all managed connections are closed reliably, matching the existing asynchronous behavior. **Changes:** - Iterate over a snapshot of `_connections` during shutdown. - Add a regression test verifying that four connections are all closed and removed. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | tests/​test_environment_close.py | Adds a regression test verifying that all managed connections are closed and `active_connections` reaches zero. | | rabbitmq_amqp_python_client/​environment.py | Iterates over a snapshot of the connection list to prevent connections from being skipped during shutdown. |
Review effort: Lite
